Thanks for the quick demo last week. We are ready to move forward but procurement has two items that need to land before we can push you through our Coupa registration and issue a PO: 1) a finalized Order Form that matches our PO schema (we run Coupa with a strict PO line/GL breakdown) and 2) confirmation that the MSA redlines we shared are accepted (attached below).

Attached: OrderForm_v3.pdf (your latest) and our annotated MSA redlines.

- Can you provide a Coupa-ready PO sample (CSV/Excel mapping for line-level fields)?

- We need a vendor code created in Coupa before the invoice flow — can you confirm your vendor tax info and W-9 will be provided?

Elena — thanks for the clear list. I'm putting legal and our finance ops on this thread to accelerate. Quick plan from our side:

1) I attached a Coupa PO mapping template (Coupa_PO_Specs.xlsx) and a sample Order Form exported as CSV that shows how we can populate line-level fields. Sergio, please confirm the field mapping is compatible.
2) We will review clause 7.2 (data residency) with legal; if there are acceptable carve-outs we can propose a limited-scope addendum for EU workloads.
3) We will send W-9 and vendor tax details to your Coupa onboarding email and can expedite vendor code creation once we have the vendor ID.

Attachments: Coupa_PO_Specs.xlsx, Redline_MSA_OrderForm_v2.docx

Next steps:
- Sergio, can you review the redlines and mark any non-starters by EOD?
- Elena / Tom, please share any Coupa vendor ID or onboarding ticket so we can push finance.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we want to onboard this week.

Best,

Subject: Re: Coupa onboarding + Order Form redlines

Hannah / Elena —

I've reviewed the annotated redlines. High-level notes:
- Most business terms are fine to accept; the two legal exceptions (highlighted) are:
  1) Broad indemnity expansion (Section 9) — propose limiting to direct damages and carve out ML model training liabilities.
  2) Data residency clause (7.2) — we can accept for EU customer data only if scope is narrow and there is an SLA for data export requests.

Operational asks for Coupa:
- I confirm the attached Coupa_PO_Specs.xlsx maps to our invoice system. Priyom, can finance prepare a sample populated CSV by tomorrow morning?
- We can accommodate the vendor code once Elena shares the Coupa vendor ID. We will send W-9 and EFT details to coupa-onboarding@northstarpharma.com — please confirm if you need additional certificates (e.g., IRS 8238).

I've created tracked redlines in Redline_MSA_OrderForm_v2.docx and left comments for Tom on the indemnity language and export SLA. If Tom is okay with our suggested carve-outs, we can accept the Order Form and move to DocuSign.

Regards,
Sergio Alvarez
Sales Operations Counsel | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwoodinference.com

From: Tom Baxter <tbaxter@northstarpharma.com>

Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@northstarpharma.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 08:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Coupa onboarding + Order Form redlines

Thanks — quick responses from legal:
- Indemnity: NorthStar can accept a limitation to direct damages but we need to preserve a minimum carve-out for IP infringement. Would you accept a mutual IP carve-out instead of unilateral liability?
- Data residency: We can narrow the clause to EU personal data only. We still require a documented SLA for data export requests (10 business days).

Operational: please provide the sample populated PO CSV and the vendor registration ticket ID (if you create it in Coupa). We will not create a vendor code until we see the W-9 and vendor EFT info.

Tom
Tom Baxter | Senior Counsel, NorthStar Pharma
tbaxter@northstarpharma.com
